{Black would have been better off capturing on d4 instead of e4. How should
White start a strong attack?} 4. dxe5 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try
again and look for a way to win material.] [%hint Capture a pawn and prepare
to advance your queen to make a queen-bishop battery against f7.]} (4. Bxf7+ $2
Kxf7 {White has no way to win back the sacrificed piece. Try again and look
for a stronger attacking option.}) (4. Bd5 $2 Nf6 {Black saves the knight and
threatens the bishop on d5. Try again and look for a better attacking move.}) (
4. Qf3 $2 d5 {Black defends the knight with a good position. Try again and
look for a strong capture.}) (4. Qe2 $2 d5 {Black defends the knight with a
good position. Try again and look for a strong capture.}) 4... Bc5 {Good
start! How should White win material?} 5. Bxf7+ {[%wrong There's a better
option. Try again and look for a powerful capture.] [%hint Sacrifice a piece

there's a simpler path to an advantage. Try to find a powerful capture.}) (5.
Nh3 $2 d6 {Black prepares Bxh3 with a complicated position. Try again and look
for a better attacking option.}) (5. Nf3 $2 Nxf2 {Black wins material in this
complicated position. Try again and look for a way to win material.}) 5... Kxf7
{Nice move! How should you win back the lost piece with a great position?} 6.
Qd5+ {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a winning fork.] 
[%hint Fork the black king and the e4-knight.]} (6. Qf3+ $5 {This is a strong
fork. See if you can find another one to fork the black king, knight and
bishop.}) (6. Qh5+ $2 Kg8 {Black keeps a material advantage. Try again and
look for a better attacking option.}) (6. Nh3 $2 d5 {Black prepares Bxh3 and
White is in trouble. Try again and look for a strong attacking move.}) 6... Ke8
{Nice work! How should White win material?} 7. Qxe4 {[%wrong There's a better
move. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Capture an undefended
piece.] Great job! White has an extra pawn and the safer king.} *

move.}) 6... g6 {Good start! How should you save the queen?} 7. Qf3 {[%wrong

undefended piece.] Well done! White wins material, although Black's lead in
development and big center offer some practical compensation.} *
